name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Between Kael and Thorne, one goes with Bard and the other with Transmutation.
Kael goes with exactly two of Bard, Crossbow, and Conjuration.
Orin goes with at least two of Rogue, Dagger, and Transmutation.
Either Orin goes with Illusion or Bard goes with Orin.

hints.text: Suppose Orin went with Bard — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.

…but now the clue “Between Kael and Thorne, one goes with Bard and the other with Transmutation” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Orin does not go with Bard.
